method: Built-in image_gen tool; transparent 3D conceptual illustrations, not client screenshots
shared_prompt: Premium 3D illustration for SparkSpace service website. Landscape 3:2, transparent background. Warm ivory ceramic, translucent lavender glass #7852db, delicate pale chrome edging. Soft studio lighting, rounded dimensional digital objects, isolated cutout, all objects fully contained with margin. No text, letters, logos, numbers, watermarks or fabricated metrics.

Ivory porcelain search window with a lavender glass magnifier beside a branching hierarchy of three connected page panels. Website structure and search, no performance metrics.

Two ivory website panels side by side: disorganized faint content blocks on the left, clear hierarchy and lavender sphere on the right. Curved lavender connector indicates conceptual rearrangement, no client before/after claim.
Ivory website browser panel examined by a lavender glass magnifier, with three lavender annotation frames around an image, button and heading. Areas to inspect, no error counts.
Ivory website browser panel beside a lavender glass gear and a small ivory checklist panel with two lavender checkmarks. Updates and functional checks, no uptime numbers.
